fields.statement: At 3c66a166 I built go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa3 ./cmd/rhiza and used it in a scratch repo with a logging fake rex and every RHIZA_* var unset. daemon settings on a fresh repo listed all 8 keys, including rhiza.autonomy.accept = auto (default), and --json gave value auto, source default. daemon set rhiza.autonomy.accept owner then settings showed owner (git config). daemon set rhiza.autonomy.accept maybe exited 2 and left the value at owner. The cycle 1 finding is fixed: with accept unset, an autonomous plan's clean gate accepted its change set, which matches the listed default.

At 3c66a166, by hand with the built binary on an autonomous plan run (hold workflow, --no-wait) whose review round was clean: with rhiza.autonomy.accept unset, run gate accepted Serve B one (by the gate: proposed, accepted). After daemon set rhiza.autonomy.accept owner, the same gate left Serve B two proposed, and inbox listed it as waiting for acceptance with next: rhiza accept --rule owner.

At 3c66a166, with the built binary and a logging fake rex, after the autonomyStage refactor: with rhiza.autonomy.ship owner, daemon --once started nothing and never called rex, and daemon status said 'Built: ship is set to owner: only the owner starts its run'. With ship auto and signoff owner, daemon --autonomous --once started one run, and rex was called with run start <cs> --permission-mode manual, without --autonomous. accept owner/auto behaved as in accept-policy-qa-3.
